title: The Kikuchi Hierarchy is Sharp for $k$XOR
summary: Planted noisy $k$XOR and the strong refutation of random $k$XOR are governed by a conjectured trade-off between signal strength and time: Level $\ell$ of the Kikuchi hierarchy should achieve the smooth curve \begin{equation*} m\ \gtrsim\ ρ^{-2}n^{k/2}/\ell^{k/2-1}\ \text{clauses} \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \text{solvable in time }n^{O(\ell)}, \end{equation*} where $ρ$ is the bias of the planted signal or, for refutation, the target advantage.
